subject: Finalize MAP: org keys, IP allowlist & VPC peering schedule
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Alex Barnes <alex.barnes@medsys.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff: org + keys + IP allowlist + peering — proposed schedule

Alex — thanks again for the quick sync today. Per our MAP, we want to lock the PO C environment details so your engineers can validate traffic and we can run the evaluation this month. High-level asks for the environment handoff: 

- Org & tenant: please add the service account user/email we provided to your tenant (redwood-eval@medsys-svc). If you prefer SAML invite, let me know the IdP metadata endpoint and we can coordinate.
- API keys: we recommend short-lived evaluation keys (30d rotation). For now we can issue two scoped keys: one for inference (read-only) and one for telemetry (metrics only).
- IP allowlist: please provide the public egress IP ranges your infra team will allow for the peering/whitelist. We will provide our egress CIDR to your Cloud team.
- VPC peering: target one-way peering from MedSys prod-vpc -> Redwood-eval-vpc. See attached template for the exact fields we need.

Proposed timeline (MAP milestones):
- 2026-09-15: MedSys confirms org invite method + account ID
- 2026-09-16: Redwood issues evaluation API keys + preliminary role scoping
- 2026-09-18: VPC peering window (maintenance) — 2 hour slot
- 2026-09-20: Smoke tests + baseline eval run

Attachments: redwood_map_v1.pdf (MAP doc), vpc_peering_template.docx

Next steps: could you confirm the AWS account ID for the peering and the best contact at CloudOps? If you confirm the 15th-20th cadence we’ll lock calendar invites.

Thanks,
Avery Johnson
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwood.com | (415) 555-0143
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Barnes <alex.barnes@medsys.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudOps Team <cloudops@bigcloud.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:08:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: org + keys + IP allowlist + peering — proposed schedule

Thanks, Avery — great outline and that timeline looks reasonable. Quick answers/notes below: 

- Org invite: we can create a service account (redwood-eval@medsys-svc) in our dev tenant and invite it. No SAML required for the POC.
- AWS account ID for peering: 987654321000 (please confirm the VPC ID you want to peer to)
- IP allowlist: our CloudOps team needs your egress IP CIDR and the port ranges you expect. Tentative egress CIDRs we will accept for the peering are 34.210.128.0/22 and 3.12.64.0/22 — please confirm.
- Peering details: we prefer to use a Transit Gateway if you support it; otherwise a standard VPC peering is OK. Please indicate whether you require route table changes on our side.

CloudOps (cc): please coordinate with Avery and Vivek on the specifics; I’ve copied you on this thread. Our preference is to schedule the peering during the 18 Sep window in the afternoon UTC — we can shift if Redwood needs an earlier slot.

Appreciate the attachments — I’ll review the MAP doc this morning and return any redlines.

Best,
Alex Barnes
Director, Platform Engineering | MedSys Health
alex.barnes@medsys.com
